caption: The drawing depicts a square, stone-like architectural element with a recessed central panel. The structure appears to be made of roughly hewn stone blocks rendered in shades of grey, brown, and muted beige, with subtle shadowing to indicate depth and dimensionality. Inside the recessed center, there are two sets of sculpted, wing-like forms, one above the other, both colored in a bluish-grey tone with darker shading along the edges to highlight their shape. In the lower right corner of the page, there is a small, hand-drawn sketch of a similar wing-like motif and the handwritten text “Tentative sketch of supposed Design”. The background is an off-white or light cream color, with some faint pencil marks and smudges around the main focus and along the drawing’s edges.
title: Keystone Design
